verdict.rationale: Runpod ships an explicitly versioned REST API (v1), and a runtime probe confirms the /v1 path and its OpenAPI spec are live. The docs also offer a migration path toward REST, which implies older interfaces such as GraphQL are being superseded. However, the pack contains no documented deprecation policy, notice period, sunset timeline, or version-support guarantees. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, a changelog or version-lifecycle documentation, an explicit deprecation status for the GraphQL API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources.
To migrate automatically, ask your coding agent to run `/runpod:migrate rest` once you've installed the Runpod skills plugin.
https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json serves the REST API's OpenAPI spec keylessly
